mapper.sql: u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.org_id, COALESCE(o.org_name, '') AS org_name, COALESCE(u.mobile_phone, '') AS mobile_phone
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = u.org_id AND o.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(u.mobile_phone, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY u.display_name, u.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = u.org_id AND o.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.id = #{userId} AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1
